notes.title: Major Update! New Levels, Enhanced Graphics, and More!
notes.content:
A major update has arrived in our game! 🎉 This update brings comprehensive improvements and new features across all areas of the game. Here’s what awaits you in the latest version:


Level Design: All levels have been redesigned, and a new level has been added to the game.
High-Quality Graphics: The game now utilizes High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP) for a more visually stunning experience.
Bug Fixes: All known bugs have been fixed, providing a smoother experience.
Sound Effects: New sounds have been added, and existing sounds have been improved. A richer atmosphere now awaits you in the game!
Character Controls: Significant improvements have been made to character controls, offering a smoother and more responsive control experience.
Chain System: Enhancements have been made to the chain system, making it more reliable and effective.
Optimization: Game performance has been increased for a faster and smoother gameplay experience.
Lobby and Menu Systems: Extensive changes have been made to the lobby and menu systems, making navigation within the game easier.
Settings Panel: The settings menu has been reorganized to be more user-friendly.


We are thrilled to share these updates that will elevate your gaming experience. Have fun! 🎮
